issues.description: The solution implements the Lecture constructor with package-private visibility (no access modifier), while the problem statement instructs students to "Create a constructor" without clarifying visibility. This can confuse students about the intended visibility (many will expect a public constructor) and may cause instantiation problems if tests or student code live in other packages. The template also does not specify the visibility in its TODO, so there is an inconsistency between implicit expectations and the solution's visibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the constructor explicitly public in the solution (and indicate the expected visibility in the problem statement and template). For example: public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors) { ... } This ensures students and external tests can instantiate Lecture without package visibility issues.
